description: This file contains the implementation of the RetrieveThingsLiveCommand, specifically the class RetrieveThingsLiveCommandImpl, which is an immutable class representing a command to retrieve 'things' in a live query context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for constructing instances, accessing command parameters, and generating related objects.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing RetrieveThingsLiveCommand, representing a command to retrieve specific 'things' with optional namespace, used in live query operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: getThingEntityIds
methods.description: Returns the list of ThingId objects representing the entities to retrieve.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the namespace string if present.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new command with the provided DittoHeaders, preserving other parameters.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing answers to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the command, including class name, superclass info, and namespace.
